Package index

Data Acquisition and Preparation

wass2s_download_cds()
Robust Parallel Downloader for CDS/ECMWF (via ecmwfr) with Year Chunking
wass2s_prepare_data()
Prepare gridded hydro-climatic data from NetCDF or stars objects
make_toy_data_by_product()
Create synthetic multi-product hydrological dataset

Statistical Forecasting

wass2s_tune_pred_stat()
Tune and refit a single product/model, select configuration by KGE
wass2s_cons_mods_stat()
Consolidate predictions across products for one statistical model
wass2s_run_basin_mods_stat()
Run basin-level statistical model consolidation and fusion
wass2s_run_basins_stat()
Run the statistical method across multiple basins
wass2s_run_pipeline_stat()
Wrapper function called by the core (run_method) for statistical pipeline

Machine Learning Forecasting

wass2s_tune_pred_ml()
Tune and predict for one product and one ML model
wass2s_cons_mods_ml()
Consolidate top-K products for one basin and one ML model
wass2s_run_bas_mod_ml()
Run basin-level machine learning model consolidation and final fusion
wass2s_run_basins_ml()
Run the Hydro + ML pipeline for all basins
wass2s_run_pipeline_hydro()
Wrapper function called by the core (run_method) for hydro (ML) pipeline

HYPE Execution

wass2s_hype_run()
Run HYPE in a given directory (non-GUI mode)
wass2s_hype_run_watchlog()
Run HYPE in "watch-log" mode (Windows GUI executables)
wass2s_hype_run_batch()
Run multiple HYPE scenarios (one directory each)
wass2s_hype_run_one_model()
Run one model workflow: prepare OBS -> update info.txt resultdir -> run HYPE
wass2s_hype_run_all_models()
Run the full workflow for all models discovered in a forcing directory
wass2s_detect_high_flow_periods()
Detect high-flow periods from daily discharge time series

Metrics and Diagnostics

wass2s_kge()
Kling-Gupta Efficiency (vector form)
wass2s_rmse()
Root Mean Squared Error (vector)
wass2s_mae()
Mean Absolute Error (vector)
wass2s_nse()
Nash–Sutcliffe Efficiency (vector)
wass2s_corr()
Pearson Correlation Coefficient (vector form)
wass2s_minmax()
Min–max normalization to a target range
wass2s_rolling_cv() make_rolling()
Robust rolling-origin CV with target number of splits

Forecast Classes and Maps

wass2s_class_from_forecast()
From forecast to class probabilities (Q1/Q3 classes by default)
wass2s_class_entropy()
Compute entropy of class probabilities (uncertainty indicator)
wass2s_plot_map()
Generic map plotter for WASS2S products (probabilities, class, metrics)

Generic Interface

run_wass2s()
High-level runner for WASS2S
run_method(<method_hydro>)
S3 entrypoint for method "hydro"
list_methods()
List available forecasting methods
hf_registry
Registry of available forecasting methods
